en: A reproduction of a medieval fresco or manuscript illumination showing two peasants harvesting grain. One figure, in a white hooded garment, kneels low to the ground tying sheaves of wheat; another, in a white tunic, cap, and bluish trousers, bends forward carrying a bundle of stalks. The scene is rustic, with multiple tied sheaves scattered across a field and a darker band, possibly a fence or woven barrier, at the bottom. There is no visible overprinted modern text on the image side.
